maya: Kicked off an A/B where v2.3-int4 is serving 10% traffic (random split). Early signs: nice p95 drop but a specific long-narrative slice shows quality drift. Posting quick metrics.

alex: drop the table pls

maya: ```
slice       | baseline v2.2-int8 | variant v2.3-int4 | rel delta
shorttext   | p95 190ms, MRR 0.87  | p95 170ms, MRR 0.88  | +1.1% MRR
long-narr    | p95 220ms, MRR 0.79  | p95 200ms, MRR 0.74  | -6.3% MRR
kb-heavy     | p95 240ms, MRR 0.81  | p95 210ms, MRR 0.80  | -1.2% MRR
```

kevin: Whoa long-narr is -6.3% which crosses our promote cutoff. How many samples?

maya: ~4.2k requests in the variant cohort for that slice. Confidence interval tight enough.

sam: Could be prompt-length dependent quant artifacts. Any token-prefix mismatch logs?

maya: Observed ~0.2% prefix mismatch + ~0.6% truncated-kv warnings in the variant logs.

jia: Ops-bot, grab 10 example sessions from the long-narr slice (session ids: l-9001..l-9010).

ops-bot: fetching logs for l-9001..l-9010 -> https://redwood.internal/g/ab-logs-1835554321 (uploaded)

alex: Per policy, autofallback triggers on relative MRR drop > 5% OR hallucation_delta > 0.5% on a critical slice. This is >5% so we should start an emergency mitigation.

kevin: Proposal: immediately reduce variant traffic on long-narr slice to 0% and keep global variant at 5% (split across shorttext/kb). Then run a targeted offline REPLAY on the long-narr corpus with full kv-warmup and contrastive-rerank.

maya: Doing the partial cut now. Marking variant tag `int4-longnarr-paused`. PR with rollback note: https://redwood.internal/pr/4499

sam: Also suggest we temporarily relax the promotion threshold for shorttext so the rollout can continue where it's safe. We sometimes make the gate slice-weight aware: if the failing slice weight < 10% of overall traffic, allow narrower promote. Long-narr is ~12% so it's borderline.

jia: I'll run a 25k-sample replay with `kv_warmup=5s` and `early_cache_fill=true`. If the offline replay still shows the gap, deploy policy will auto-roll back the variant entirely. I'll post the replay artifacts.

kevin: After replay, if mismatch reproduces, try a hybrid: switch to `int4-hybrid` (kv-sensitive path enabled) and run a 2% quiet burn. If that looks clean, we can re-ramp with a higher canary hysteresis.

alex: Also add a cross-slice weighted metric to the dashboard (weighted MRR delta) so a single heavy slice doesn't veto safe ramps unless it exceeds its weight*threshold.

maya: ACK. I'll attach the new dashboard panel to the PR and update the rollout plan: ramp 2% -> 5% -> 10% but long-narr slice pinned to 0% until confirmed.

jia: Monitoring alerts set. Will ping #incidents if auto-fallback fires.

maya: Thanks team. We'll reconvene once replay artifacts are in. :thumbsup:
